description: Prevalence and Determinants of Speeding Survey - QLD is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Department of Transport and Main Roads, Qld. The Department of Transport and Main Roads conducts an annual survey of Queensland motorists focusing on road safety attitudes and behaviours, as well as support for our safety initiatives. Since 2020 this annual survey has primarily focused on speeding, speed enforcement, roadworks, and school zone safety. Coverage is Queensland, 2018 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
